How to choose a generation model

Start with a task, define quality, and compare like-for-like.

RunBridge AI · Field notes 2 min read

Start with an outcome

Write down what the user needs to accomplish. A support reply, product image and short video need different evaluation criteria. Pick a specific task before comparing model names.

Build a small evaluation set

Use representative inputs from your product. Include straightforward requests, ambiguous instructions and cases where the model should fail gracefully. Keep inputs consistent across candidates.

Compare the whole experience

Review output quality, request latency, supported inputs and estimated cost together. For images and video, align resolution and generation settings before comparing results.

Keep a versioned decision

Record the model version, prompt, settings and evaluation date. Repeat the evaluation when a relevant model changes or your product requirements shift.
